title: Field intake brief and scope sifter for Sales/CS enterprise asks
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Create a repeatable, lightweight process and one-page artifact (the 'Field Intake Brief') to consolidate Sales/CS enterprise feature requests, prioritize them quickly, and hand off a recommended initial scope to Eng + Design. Goal: reduce friction in first-pass scoping, surface risks early (security, infra, data residency), and produce consistent inputs for backlog triage or a short-term design spike.
acceptance_criteria: A 1-page Field Intake Brief template exists and is stored in Confluence with example filled from a real request
Sales/CS can populate the brief within 30 minutes using a short form (Google/Drive) and get an automated score
PM review process defined (2 business-day SLA) and rollout comms prepared for frontline teams
Tie-outs: the brief produces a recommended initial prioritization (Must/Should/Could) and an estimated engineering size bucket (S/M/L)
deliverables: Field Intake Brief template (Confluence) with guidance and examples
Short intake form (Drive) that maps to the template fields
Triage rubric (scoring weights) and implementation notes for automation
Rollout email + Slack templates for Sales/CS + AE onboarding
A pilot summary doc with 6 sample requests and resulting scopes
triage_rubric_summary: Security / compliance risk (data residency, PII): weight 15%
Strategic alignment / platform leverage (reusable infra): weight 10%
field_brief_template_fields: Value hypothesis / expected outcome (revenue, retention, ops)
Proposed user flow or example payload
Suggested acceptance criteria / initial evaluation set
implementation_notes: Pilot intake form will map fields to Confluence template and compute a rubric score
PMs will review briefs and assign a size bucket (S/M/L) within 2 business days
High-security flags escalate to Security for a 24h intake review
If rubric score >= 80 (out of 100) and size <= M => propose a scoped spike (2 week) else route to backlog
For requests with clear infra/ops impacts, include 'Dedicated' track checkbox to indicate potential Dedicated/Private deployment needs
notes_and_tradeoffs: Trade-off: a lightweight brief speeds throughput but may miss edge technical constraints; include mandatory 'known blockers' field to mitigate
We won't attempt full engineering estimates here — only S/M/L buckets to keep turnaround low
Automation vs manual review: start manual for the pilot (PM-led) and add an automated score reminder after 6 weeks
Avoid gating sales pursuit — the brief must not be a hard blocker to close a deal; it's a planning artifact for PM/Eng prioritization
